title: Crypto Exchange HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With FCA
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Crypto Exchange HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With FCA 

HTX is leaving the UK under a confidential FCA settlement that ends its first crypto marketing case, while sanctions from the UK and EU remain in place.

This post Crypto Exchange HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With FCA  first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Centralized Exchange and DeFi Losses Dominate 2026 Crypto Hacks Despite Hardware Wallet Failures
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Centralized Exchange and DeFi Losses Dominate 2026 Crypto Hacks Despite Hardware Wallet Failures

Lightning.news data shared with Bitcoin Magazine puts net 2026 crypto hack losses at roughly $2.35 billion after freezes and returns. September alone accounted for about $768 million, led by Bitget’s September 24 hot-and-warm wallet drain and Liquid Network’s Elements bug.

This post Centralized Exchange and DeFi Losses Dominate 2026 Crypto Hacks Despite Hardware Wallet Failures first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt.
